retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.

the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.

POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.

retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.

messages.content: You are a performance test engineer. Follow the task's output contract.

Preserve a JMX flow that extracts a redirect location and follows a one-use token.
Translate the supplied JMX to k6.
Execution contract: {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "redirect"}. Non-workload counts are iterations per user. One committed order per journey, no duplicate/extra carts. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{"login_redirect": true, "require_challenge": true}, {"login_redirect": true, "require_challenge": true, "html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].
Rubric/gates (per case: earned fraction capped by every prerequisite fraction; average all cases, never best case):
loads: 10 points — target loads Requires: none.
setup: 25 points — correct redirect handling Requires: loads.
behavior: 40 points — dynamic location/token is extracted and consumed in sequence Requires: loads, setup.
safety: 25 points — no extra redirect requests or token reuse across iterations. Requires: loads, behavior.
Malformed/non-executable artifacts earn zero execution-gated credit. A prerequisite fault can lose multiple checkpoints.

Fixture protocol.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

messages.content: You are a performance test engineer. Follow the task's output contract.

Convert CSV-driven JMeter users and parameter substitution into deterministic k6 fixture use.
Translate the supplied JMX to k6.
Execution contract: {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "data"}. Non-workload counts are iterations per user. One committed order per journey, no duplicate/extra carts. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{}, {"html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].
Use accounts.json rows per VU, preserve numeric quantity, use each row once per iteration. JMX CSVs represent the same records.
Read-only /fixtures aliases: {"m04-accounts.json": "accounts.json", "m04-account-1.csv": "account-1.csv", "m04-account-2.csv": "account-2.csv"}
Rubric/gates (per case: earned fraction capped by every prerequisite fraction; average all cases, never best case):
loads: 10 points — target loads the allowed fixture Requires: none.
setup: 25 points — all record fields retain their types Requires: loads.
behavior: 40 points — correct per-user rows/cookies across iterations Requires: loads, setup.
safety: 25 points — no skipped/duplicated records and required checkout totals match. Requires: loads, behavior.
Malformed/non-executable artifacts earn zero execution-gated credit. A prerequisite fault can lose multiple checkpoints.

Fixture protocol.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.

Fixture protocol.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

messages.content: You are a performance test engineer. Follow the task's output contract.

Migrate nested conditional/loop controllers with a bounded refresh branch.
Translate the supplied JMX to k6.
Execution contract: {"users": 2, "iterations": 2, "mode": "expiry"}. Non-workload counts are iterations per user. One committed order per journey, no duplicate/extra carts. Two fixture variants count equally; the same artifact is reused without feedback. Fresh owner seeds are recorded after execution. Profiles: [{"expire_after": 2}, {"expire_after": 2, "html_layout": 1, "reverse_catalog": true}]. Negative-control overrides: [].

Fixture protocol.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

Fixture protocol.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

response.text:
I'll analyze the broken artifact and produce a corrected JMX that properly detects the JSON decline (`accepted:false`) and fails the assertion, while keeping the rest of the journey valid.

Key defects in the supplied artifact:
1. `ResponseAssertion-43` on `/v2/orders` uses `.*` (matches anything) — accepts `accepted:false` HTTP 200.
2. No assertion that `accepted:true` is present; no negative-control sensitivity.
3. `RegexExtractor-10`/`-11` use `$^` (never matches) — cart/hasCart never set from login.
4. `RegexExtractor-7` etc. use `template=true` (literal "true") instead of `$1$`.
5. `IfController-20` uses `${redirect}` which is `true`/`false` string — boolean-expression mode needs a real boolean expression.
6. `RegexExtractor-9` form regex is fragile; needs to handle attribute variants.
7. `RegexExtractor-37` `hasCart` regex is fine but `RegexExtractor-10` overrides it with `$^`.
8. `JSONPostProcessor-28` uses JSONPath filter expressions that JMeter's JSONPath (Jayway) may not evaluate as expected for `in_stock == true`; safer to use `$..products[?(@.variants[0].in_stock==true)]` — but to be robust, use a simpler path and rely on server returning in-stock first, or use `$..products[0].id` fallback. I'll keep filter but add fallback defaults.
9. `Idempotency-Key` uses `${cart}` — must be unique per cart and stable on retry; using cart id is acceptable (stable per cart).
10. `If-Match` header sent on all requests including GETs — harmless but noisy; keep only where needed. I'll leave it (server ignores on GET).
11. Missing reservation flow — protocol says reservations optional (`reservation_id?`), so skipping is acceptable, but the decline mode is about orders returning `accepted:false`. The core fix is the order assertion.
12. `ResponseAssertion-17` on login uses `"csrf"\s*:` — fine.
13. `ResponseAssertion-36` on cart uses `"id"\s*:\s*"cart-` — fine but assumes id prefix; keep.

The critical fix: replace `ResponseAssertion-43` with a **negative** assertion that fails when `"accepted"\s*:\s*false` appears, AND a **positive** assertion that `"accepted"\s*:\s*true` appears. In decline mode the server returns `accepted:false` with HTTP 200, so the positive assertion fails → intended assertion failure (not a crash). The negative assertion also fails. Either way the plan fails the intended check.

I'll use two ResponseAssertions on the orders sampler:
- `ResponseAssertion-43a`: test_type=2 (contains), pattern `"accepted"\s*:\s*true` — fails on decline.
- `ResponseAssertion-43b`: test_type=6 (NOT contains), pattern `"accepted"\s*:\s*false` — fails on decline.

Also fix the broken extractors and IfController.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS or JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (k6 __ENV.BASE_URL; JMeter host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.
